consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the second set of the show, particularly the Terrapin>Drums>Dark Star sequence, is a standout highlight, showcasing impressive improvisational skills from the band. While the first set received mixed reviews, the energy and performance quality in the latter half left a lasting impression on many attendees.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 34 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The overwhelming praise for the second set, especially the Terrapin jam, elevates the overall sentiment despite some criticisms of the first set.
